A wild Jomon-style experience. In a vast field under open sky, you'll start by gathering firewood, then prepare lunch using vegetables grown in natural cultivation fields.

【Fee】¥7,000 per person (includes meal ingredients, guide, insurance, etc.)

【Capacity】6 people

【Guide】Chikyukko Farm staff

【What to bring】Long boots, work gloves, hat, towel, clothes suitable for farm work, long boots (if you have them), change of clothes (recommended), drinks
